change_log: Round fix: lifecycle_projection.labeled_reason (imported by the replay) is kept, as are every public (non-underscore) name of all seven modules and every surface name. lifecycle_monitor_runner: _emit became the pure _records (records emitted in the same order with the same fields); _judge's persistence logic became the pure _verdict; _finish/_judge flag write folded into _cycle, which still commits each window on its own and judges/flags inside the last window's transaction (an empty transaction when none is due); _recorded folded into _plan with the same SELECT; _row folded into _append with the same column order and insert ... on conflict do nothing; _unavailable now returns the emitted record (same event, message, field order) and run derives MonitorSummary from collected outcomes; _reading_id takes the target instead of the cycle. _append keeps its (cycle, window, readings, not_run) signature and the attributes _rules/_append/_evidence/_monitored/_engine keep their roles. lifecycle_store: _applied, _flag_id and _refuse folded (same SQL in the same order: standing, then events for the closed flag id, refusal check order unchanged, refusal written in its own transaction with IntegrityError suppressed, TransitionRefused raised from None); the duplicate distinct (signal, version) query is one _pairs helper with identical statement text; _bound/act replaced by lambdas in bind_writers that call store.transition at call time; standing remains the instance method transition and admitted call. lifecycle_evidence: _lookback inlined into LiveEvidence.for_window; _consumed, baseline_view, live_evidence, for_window still looked up at call time. lifecycle_projection: private helpers folded into signal_standing, evaluated in the original order. lifecycle_seams: nested monitored/evidence/for_window replaced by pure _monitored and _per_window plus lambdas; baseline_view is now imported at call time. lifecycle_root: nested standing inlined into the loop with the same call order. lifecycle_group: _window inlined into readings; _compare returns its lines and code and readings echoes them (same text); command docstrings and help text untouched. Docstrings and comments of private code shortened. Deliberately not preserved: removed private helpers not in the surface (_bound, _applied, _flag_id, _refuse, _emit, _finish, _judge, _recorded, _row, _lookback, _latest_basis, _baseline, _reading, _latest_and_not_run, _flag, _state, _window); a refusal now carries no suppressed __context__ in the concurrent-clash path (cause stays None).
